access.scenario: Authored illustrative future access from the Kotel plaza level (Z -1432.5) up to the Mount platform deck (Z 0) along the OpeningV2 corridor. Not an existing bridge, not a surveyed or halachic access, not a structural design.
access.zLiftReason: The V2 deck top and the platform deck are both Z 0 from the platform edge (x -13597 at the corridor Y) to x -12500; a 2 cm lift avoids coplanar z-fighting and is far below the 55 cm step height.
access.materialsNote: Same review stone materials the platform deck (PavingReview) and skirt (WallReview) already carry, so the stair reads as part of the platform. Not Kotel stone; the Kotel surface is owned elsewhere.

tiling.reason: release-capture-20260908T001321Z a_exterior_wide_arrival.png and release-capture-20260907T220013Z i_overhead_city.png: the dry-ground set repeats as a regular speck grid on every slope east of the platform; city walls in h_bus_street_level.png show 1 m Lego blocks (stone_block_wall real size is 2.1 m, tiled at 3.5 m); buildings read as one uniform beige because the four tints differ by under 10 percent.
tiling.methodPolicy: UE 5.8 Python has no MaterialEditingLibrary default-parameter setter. Method 1 edits the parameter expressions' default_value (get_material_expressions is BlueprintPure in the installed header; editor_only_data.expression_collection is the reflected fallback) and verifies with the exposed default getters. Method 2 (automatic fallback) creates one MaterialInstanceConstant child per parent and overrides slot 0 on every StaticMeshComponent of this map that carries the parent; parents and mesh assets stay untouched.

trees.reason: Handoff rule: no trees on the Mount. The integrated map carries the L_FutureMount removal (trunks 4265, crowns 12795 in native-apply-20260907T215118571170Z.json); this fix verifies the live instances against the inferred enclosure polygon and removes only instances whose trunk/crown XY falls inside it.

sky.reason: Every exterior view since the lighting apply (release-capture-20260907T220013Z and 20260908T001321Z) shows the horizon band black/dark brown; release-capture-20260907T210550Z (same camera, before the MI_Cloud_Scattered swap) showed a blue horizon. The scattered cloud deck seen edge-on reads as a dark overcast wall. Lighting is owned by the sanctuary-balance task; this fix is opt-in only.

limitations: Geometric and asset-level changes only; visual acceptance needs a fresh real-RHI capture and a bounded walk probe along the new stair.
The access stair is an authored future interpretation over the OpeningV2 corridor; it does not cut, hide or move any retained wall, terrain, plaza or Kotel geometry.
OpeningV2 obstacle clearance was verified against the 1,952 retained city-wall boxes only; buildings and terrain along the corridor were not clipped or tested.
Material parameter changes alter shared StaticMesh dependencies: donor maps may look different although their .umap bytes are unchanged.
